versionGroups.label: workspace protocol (local @core/@adapters/... packages keep workspace:* — not version-checked)

single version across the monorepo (ADR-0018 single-version invariant for DIRECT/catalog deps; consumer-governed TRANSITIVES are not manifest-declared so they are invisible to this group and may legitimately coexist — vite 7.3.5/8.x, minimatch multi-versions, etc.)

semverGroups.label: exact ranges only — no ^ ~ * >= on literal specs (ADR-0018). catalog:/catalog:otel refs report UnsupportedMismatch in `syncpack lint` because syncpack@12 cannot evaluate the catalog protocol; that is tooling noise, not a range violation, so the CI gate runs `syncpack list-mismatches` (single-version + literal-range invariant, exit 0) instead of `lint`. Exactness for catalog-managed deps is structurally guaranteed by catalogMode:strict + save-prefix="" + the catalog values being exact pins.
